C0976.title: League of Legends Player Banned for Intentionally Feeding Loses Lawsuit Against Tencent
C0976.summary: In January 2020, League of Legends player Dai was reported by teammates and opponents for 'intentional feeding' across four games, leading to a system-determined penalty of a 7-day ban for negative gameplay. Dai argued he was merely unskilled and sued Tencent for compensation and an apology. The court ruled that Tencent's notarized backend data proved Dai's negative gameplay, making the ban reason
